items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: We played 'Casa Mañana' just before we went to do 'Cabin in the Sky.' ... No this is a cabaret for Billy Rose. He had the 'Casa Mañana' restaurant. We played there for him for about six weeks.

ctx.x: Oh, I played Billy Rose's "Casa Mañana." We played "Casa Mañana" just before we went to do "Cabin in the Sky." And we had to do that at the MGM studio, I think it was.
